observations.text: Crossing washes joined pale sea lanes.
Broad crossing rock planes closed an early pale shelf gap; regular bristles remained.
Wider forward breast reduced an early goose-like neck and tail overlap closed split ends.
Long bill and two pink legs established a standing bird; the sea gap was reserved rather than covered later.
Warm iris survived whole view; cool chest light became an isolated raised stripe.
Dark neighbor shortened chest stripe; wider warm wing separated from belly, leaving relief.
Single loaded eye reflection stayed compact and visible at whole view.
Feather division became a continuous dark band.
Pale toes met soft dark contacts without closing leg gap.
Algae differentiated rock; fissure became too sharp and zigzagged.
Stone neighbors shortened fissure; watercolor pool reflection remained too faint.
Loaded oil made pool reflection visible where watercolor had little effect.
Narrow pool rims formed pointed hooks.
Broader planes widened pool ends and reduced hook silhouette, retaining stepped edges.
Dark barnacle centers lowered lights; warm wing neighbors broke band color but retained relief.
Sea gestures stayed faint and subordinate.
Sampled crown light remained quiet; outer head was still faceted.
Narrow leg lights retained the open gap.
Sampled seaweed arcs were gentler than three-point elbows; stone facets left pale ends.
Unequal pool lights remained a ridged ribbon.
Broad plumage joins quieted color but left raised seams.
Stone neighbors shortened pale ends; watery foot shadows stayed soft.
Final chest/fissure/tail/bill refinement retained focal eye and reserved leg gap. Faceted edges, regular bristles and relief remained; further covers unlikely to improve form.

limitations: The first whole screenshot was observed but not saved; its close screenshot remains locally. All subsequent pairs saved with explicit counts. Two camera-click timeouts were followed by fresh state inspection and successful settled review before further paint. Whole/close clips were actual full-page browser screenshots cropped to the canvas wrapper; close view was confirmed at 2.0×. Center close clips head and lower shelf by design; upper/lower pans cover those. Screenshot bytes JPEG, actual artwork export PNG.
